fixture_issues: Mileage notebook photo lists 1,150 'misc — other client errands (see pg 2)' miles but page 2 is not in the pack and the client script has no fact releasing it; the reference line 9 (2,562), line 31 and SE tax all count those miles as substantiated business miles. A preparer who excludes unsubstantiated miles cannot hit the key.

The reference also treats the 2,232 home->Capital Factory coworking round trips as business miles; the library Pub 463 excerpt ('driving between your home and your main or regular place of work' is commuting, deductible only if a qualifying home office exists) makes exclusion a defensible reading. Combined with the page-2 issue, the key's line 9/31/SE values are reachable only under the most aggressive defensible position. Recommend the campaign owner consider treating line 31 and SE tax as diagnostic for this case, or widening the line 31 tolerance.
Line 9 oracle conditional ('exact if commute asked; if not asked, must appear in QUESTIONS/assumptions') makes the item easier for runs that did not ask the commute question than for runs that did.
Bank export filename says 2024-12 to 2026-01 and the PDF header says period to January 31, 2026, but the last row is 2025-12-12; all five runs flagged this. Harmless but noisy.
A 2024-12-30 H-E-B row exists; the classification oracle expects 'personal' for H-E-B, but prior_year is also a reasonable label for a 2024 row. Graded as pass either way.

cross_run_observations: No run tripped the trust gate on its final deliverable, and all five caught all six traps unprompted (line 1 = 50,750 in every run; 0.70 rate; prior-year Tessaro; commute excluded; BCBS to Schedule 1; personal items off Schedule C). All five fail line 31 and SE tax for the same reason: none accepted both the 1,150 'see pg 2' miles and the home->coworking trips as business, which the key requires (A, B, C, D claim only 262-278 miles; E claims 1,428). The grade therefore separates runs mainly on secondary judgment (MacBook de minimis: C dropped it; Tartine meal: B dropped it) rather than on the traps. Four of five (A, B, D, E) wrote invented facts or out-of-library citations into the pre-review deliverable and then removed them in the review turn — storage unit (A), fabricated email quotes (B), invented rationales (D), IRC 61/162/164 citations and a false box-4 claim (E); C alone was clean throughout. The review turn is doing real work in this case; grading finals only masks that. B's JSON puts net profit on line 28 and 0.00 on line 31, so a mechanical reader of lines.31 gets 0. B and E labelled STATUS as COMPLETE despite listed unknowns. D mislabels W-2 code DD as dependent care. Recommend treating line 31/SE tax as diagnostic (or widening tolerance) for this case because the key depends on an absent notebook page.
